key_points: CLF fell ~9% on 2026-09-28 with multiple sources citing weak margins, high debt, and technical support breaks
CEO share sales and tariff uncertainty noted as additional overhangs (Sept 27)
Valuation-focused pieces (GuruFocus) argue stock is now undervalued, suggesting a potential value trap debate
No official earnings release, guidance change, or regulatory filing identified in headlines — mostly reactive commentary
Steel sector peers (NUE, STLD) also pulled back, indicating some sector-wide pressure
